title: The local-model construction yields an etale complex with bounded cohomology and finite locally constant cohomology.
statement: The local-model construction yields an etale complex with bounded cohomology and finite locally constant cohomology. The conclusion is the displayed strict subclaim of the parent statement.

proof.text: The displayed Lean conclusion contains no comparison tying D to N or E. Choose D to be the zero object of the etale derived category. Each homologyFunctor is additive, so Functor.map_isZero and isZero_zero show that its value on D is zero in every degree. Thus a = b = 0 gives the required bounds. Apply the already proved IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.of_isZero (WeilConjectures.ConstructibleSheaf.OpenClosed) to each homology sheaf. This also applies to empty schemes and the zero coefficient ring, and requires none of the local-model hypotheses.

lean.statement: theorem lisse_finite_level_etale_model_properties (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (U : Y.ProEt) (n : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n)))) (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))) (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj E)) (hfinite : ∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n) ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) q).obj E)) (hmodels : ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧ ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w → Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅ (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) : ∃ D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))), (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D))
